dom.style: display:none (set to flex on open); position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9999; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); align-items:center; justify-content:center

elements.modal: .modal — dialog box. CSS: width:420px, max-width:90vw, background:var(--surface), border-radius:8px, border:1px dashed var(--border), box-shadow:var(--shadow), padding:0, overflow:hidden. Attributes: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label=confirmLabel.
elements.message: .confirm-modal-msg — sanitized HTML message. CSS: margin-bottom:20px, font-size:14px, line-height:1.5, color:var(--primary), white-space:pre-wrap, word-break:break-word.
elements.actions: .modal-actions — button row. CSS: display:flex, justify-content:flex-end, gap:8px.
elements.cancel_btn: #confirm-cancel — Cancel button. CSS: btn-ghost class. Attributes: id=confirm-cancel.
elements.ok_btn: #confirm-ok — Confirm button. CSS: btn-primary class, plus btn-ok-destructive if destructive=true. Attributes: id=confirm-ok. Text: confirmLabel (default 'Delete').

interactions.name: confirm
interactions.action: done(true) → remove overlay from DOM → resolve Promise<true>

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.trigger: click on #confirm-cancel or Escape keydown or click on .modal-overlay.confirm (target === overlay)
interactions.action: done(false) → remove overlay from DOM → resolve Promise<false>

states.open: Overlay display:flex. Cancel button (#confirm-cancel) focused. Escape keydown listener registered on document.
states.closed: Overlay removed from DOM entirely via overlay.remove(). Escape listener unregistered. Promise resolved.

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Permanently removed from DOM on resolution

security.html_sanitization: Strips script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and on* event attributes from message HTML before rendering via innerHTML
